adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that in lib/tasks/disqus.thor, the `method_option :category` line was removed (line 117 in the old file), but the code that used `options[:category]` to set `category_id` was also removed. The old code had `category_id = Category.where(name: options[:category]).first.try(:id)` and passed it to PostCreator. The new code uses `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])` which doesn't accept a category parameter. This means existing scripts using `--category/-c` will fail because the option is no longer defined, and there's no way to specify a category for imported topics.
